name: cosmic-transcriber-web
description: Cloudflare-hosted universal web edition of Cosmic Transcriber; behavioral baseline desktop 1.0.27.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run tests/integration --config vitest.integration.config.js
scripts.test:e2e:firefox-key-stress: npm run build && node scripts/playwright-invoke.mjs test --project=firefox --grep "secure key setup, native controls, queue, mocked transcript and downloads" --repeat-each=10 --workers=1
scripts.validate:full: npm run validate:version && npm run validate && npm run validate:powershell && npm run test:worker && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e:core && npm run build:inspect
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/deploy-verify.mjs staging && node scripts/apply-registry-migrations.mjs staging && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/inspect-build.mjs && node scripts/wrangler-invoke.mjs deploy --strict --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/deploy-verify.mjs production && node scripts/apply-registry-migrations.mjs production && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/inspect-build.mjs && node scripts/wrangler-invoke.mjs deploy --strict --env production
scripts.deps:update: npm update --ignore-scripts && npm run deps:install-scripts:verify && npm rebuild && npm run browsers:install && npm audit && npm run validate:full
scripts.deps:latest: node scripts/deps-latest.mjs && npm run deps:install-scripts:verify && npm rebuild && npm run browsers:install && npm audit && npm run validate:full
scripts.deps:verify: npm ls --all && npm audit && npm run deps:install-scripts:verify && node scripts/playwright-invoke.mjs --version && node scripts/wrangler-invoke.mjs --version && npm run validate:full
scripts.browsers:install: node scripts/playwright-invoke.mjs install chromium firefox webkit
scripts.browsers:install:all: node scripts/playwright-invoke.mjs install chromium firefox webkit chrome msedge
scripts.browsers:install:ci: node scripts/playwright-invoke.mjs install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit
